title: GPS Physio Tracker

detail_text: This Sources Sought is in support of Market Research being conducted by the Alabama Army National Guard, and is issued for information and planning purposes only. This is not a Request for Proposal (or solicitation) or an indication that a contractual commitment will exist for this requirement. The Government does not intend to award a contract on the basis of this market research. The Alabama National Guard is requesting information pursuant to FAR PART 10, to identify potential sources to procure Black Ohm SIGMA-X _ Alpha GPS Physio Tracker Package listed below: 10 each - BLK-7000556ALP-5Y/ Alpha Tracker 5yrs Service 1 each - BLK-ALPHA-CHG Charging Case/ Black Ohm Alpha Charging Case_ Includes Alpha Charging Case with 25 tracker capacity 190 each - BLK-703002SIG-X Personnel and Asset GPS Tracker with Global Commercial and Private Cellular connectivity and field replaceable hot swappable batteries. 1 each - BLK-7000556MS-5Y Monitoring Laptop_ Includes Ruggedized Laptop
